extension_rule.rule: screen_protocol.md sec.3.1 -- screen positions 1-100; if included papers < 75, continue into the reserve in permutation order in blocks of 50 until 75 included papers or position 400, whichever first; started blocks are never truncated.
extension_rule.verdict: The rule fired and stopped after block R3. Blocks ['R4'] were screened beyond the stopping point and are a POST-HOC extension; they are reported separately and never silently pooled into the pre-registered denominator.

floor.adjudicated_kappa: undefined -- one category, and 1.000 BY CONSTRUCTION; not a reliability statistic and the floor is NOT assessed against it

agreement.what_the_floor_is_assessed_against: The counterfactual v1.2 encoding of the SAME four sealed files. It is a re-expression, not an independent re-rating. A genuine post-amendment reliability estimate requires a fresh independent four-screener re-coding under v1.2, which has NOT been run.
agreement.reserve_blocks_are_single_coded: Every reserve record was coded by ONE screener, so no reserve record contributes any agreement information. All 4-rater reliability in this paper rests on the 15 overlap papers of the original analysis sample.
